label: Graph to Walls
description: Stroke a graph into mitred walls, taking each wall's thickness from the Segment schema (role wall-thickness). The wall solid follows Justification (default center); the centerline is always what you snap to. Show Inner / Outer Dimension dimension the room-facing and street-facing faces — inner vs outer is decided from the enclosed room geometry; Show Center Dimension dimensions the centerline. Wire a Schema node into the Schema input; only wall-typed segments are drawn.
